_comment: Kokoro is a LOCAL provider: no API key, no credits, no audio leaves this machine. torch has no Python 3.14 wheels, so the model runs in .venv-kokoro (3.12) through scripts/acs/kokoro_worker.py. Models are downloaded only when --allow-model-download is passed, and they live outside git (see .gitignore).

narrator.description: Spanish female (Kokoro grade: fair). Narration default.

elder.description: Spanish male, lower and slower. The bell-keeper.

young.description: Spanish male, brighter and faster. The apprentice.

limits.note: Only three Spanish voices ship with Kokoro-82M v1.0. Casting is by voice + speed, not by timbre range.
